registered: 2026-10-12, before any public development question of PUBLIC-DEV-DECISIONS-01 is drawn or solved
rule: a public development question (its scenario id) is a LEG question when int(sha256(salt + ':question:' + scenario_id)[:8], 16) / 2**32 < leg_share, otherwise a VALUE question
legs: VERIFY-R's legs (v1, v3, v5) are scored on LEG questions only, each question's solved candidate grid being its verification bank
value: the selection's decision value is computed on VALUE questions only; no question is ever both
sizing: leg_share is a registered parameter, fixed before the draw; the run's size follows the owner-confirmed budget (USD 8 gives about 32 resolved per half; USD 16 about 64)
